perf.summary: DiscreteLog is a pure pass-through wrapper around Bsgs with two dead private helpers; it adds an indirection layer and unused code.
perf.currentCost: DiscreteLog.Run just forwards to Bsgs.Run. The private ModMul/ModPow methods are never called within this file (Bsgs has its own copies), so they are dead code. The wrapper adds an extra (likely inlined, but source-noise) call layer and duplicates the helper pattern.
perf.proposedChange: Either delete DiscreteLog and have callers use Bsgs.Run directly, or mark DiscreteLog.Run with [MethodImpl(AggressiveInlining)] and delete the two unused private ModMul/ModPow methods. Keeping one public alias is fine for discoverability, but the dead helpers should go.
perf.rationale: Removes dead code (smaller compile surface), clarifies the API (Bsgs is the real implementation), and AggressiveInlining guarantees the pass-through is free under Burst rather than relying on the JIT.
perf.risk: None for behavior. If DiscreteLog is the intended public name and Bsgs the internal one, keep DiscreteLog and inline-forward; just remove the unused helpers.
